notes.title: Update October
notes.content:
Hey Battle Beat Arena warriors! 🎮⚔️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039767/2f5582ada2b90cedf4db2d4a691c09e7aedd5959.png[/img]
I’ve got some fresh updates for you straight from the development forge, where pixels meet magic and rhythm drives the beat!


3D Models & Animations: Almost Ready to Dance!
Characters and animations are this close to showing off their battlefield dance moves! 💃🕺 Elves, Techs, and Humans are flexing like they own the place—just need to polish a few shiny bowstrings and helmets. Indie dev is tough, but hey, who knew war machines needed so much glitter? 

Factions Update: Elves, Techs, and Humans Are Ready to Rock!
The Elves, with their unicorns, phoenixes, and sneaky rangers, are sharpening their arrows and laying traps as we speak. 🏹🌲

The Techs? They’ve tuned their steam machines to perfection – gears, cogs, and explosions galore! ⚙️💥
And the Red Griffons (aka the Humans) have been sipping tea and practicing their battle cries. "For glory!" …or something equally dramatic. 🦅⚔️

Next Up: Orcs and Outsiders
Now, let’s talk about those Orcs… 🐗 They’re next in line, and rumor has it they’re bringing a serious attitude problem to the battlefield. As for the Outsiders, expect frogs, turtles, and all sorts of wild surprises – Flippy the Frog and Tortugon are stretching their legs and getting ready for a hopping good time. 🐸🐢

Music Rhythm Game Logic: Almost Complete!
Now for the beat-dropping news: the music rhythm game logic is nearly complete! 🎶 Imagine battling through a tactical strategy RPG with the power of sick beats. Soon, you’ll be mastering the rhythm while crushing your enemies in turn-based combat. Who says you can’t multitask?

So, here’s where we are:

3D models and animations? Almost done, just need a bit more polish and some war paint.
Elves, Techs, and Humans? Battle-ready.
Orcs and Outsiders? Coming up, and they’re bringing the noise!
Rhythm game logic? Get your dancing shoes, ‘cause it’s almost showtime! 🕺💥
We’re getting close to delivering an epic experience that blends strategy, fantasy, and rhythm. Until then, stay tuned, stay hyped, and maybe practice your best battle-cry-in-the-shower routine. 🎤🎶

After these next steps I will publish a DEMO that you can check yourself, if you want to join the crew. 

Catch you soon on the battlefield! 


Best,
Fabian 👾

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039767/2b3e03c91cc967b631c713ffa0390e611c6d7113.png[/img]

I'm excited to share some great news and updates with you.

First and foremost, I'm thrilled to announce that a demo for [b]Battle Beat Arena[/b] will be available at the [b]Steam Festival[/b]! This will be your first opportunity to dive into the epic realm of Jarenara and experience our turn-based strategy RPG firsthand. We can’t wait to hear your feedback and see you mastering the battlefield.


Development Progress:
In terms of development, we have some exciting updates to share:

The first 3 levels of the game are now fully finished. We’re polishing them to ensure a challenging and engaging experience for you.
We're currently focusing on developing the Elven faction. Here’s a sneak peek at what the Elves bring to the battlefield:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039767/14f31ab37e9f89a57de3d7415b5d8e00b3aff38e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039767/afa41f0b8b14e26af4ee54ea3d55d9bc528b36e5.png[/img][/url]

[b]Summon Creatures:[/b] Elves can summon powerful wolves, majestic phoenixes, and stealthy panthers to aid them in combat.
[b]Archery Skills: [/b]Their expertise in archery allows them to strike enemies from a distance with precision.
[b]Trap Laying:[/b] Elves can lay intricate traps to outsmart their foes.
[b]Nature Magic: [/b]Harnessing the power of nature, e.g. they can summon tornados to wreak havoc on the battlefield.
[b]Passive Ability - Ambush[/b]: This unique ability allows Elves to deal extra damage when attacking from concealment or advantageous positions.
We’re working hard to bring these features to life and can’t wait for you to experience them in the game.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039767/05867267a19dadefd7dffa645e01b820aad41666.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039767/0ed640e65b29ed33bba4c1245214eac6c07a8d60.png[/img][/url]

Stay tuned for more updates and mark your calendars for the Steam Festival . We’re eager to share more about Battle Grid Arena and get your thoughts on the demo.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm!

Best,
Fabian
